messages:
Alex Chen: Quick status check: token-cost attribution instrumentation — where are we on event schema, latency tags, and a smoke run in staging? Need owners and blockers. cc @Priya @Dylan
Priya Patel: Working on the schema PR now. Added fields for token_count, cost_usd, model_id and latency_ms. Example event I'm proposing:
```json
{
  "event_type": "inference_call",
  "timestamp": 1680000000,
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "model_id": "gemini-7b",
  "token_count": 42,
  "cost_usd": 0.0034,
  "latency_ms": 120,
  "kv_caching": false,
  "client_team": "product-search"
}
```
Dylan Reyes: Noted. When I ran the staging ingest earlier the latency breakdown query failed — some events missing kv_caching so the JOIN explodes. Logs: s3://redwood-logs/staging/instr/2026-03-16/part-0001.log. I'll try to reproduce and post the failing SQL snippet on the PR.
InfraBot: Deploy succeeded: instr-service v1.4.2 -> staging :rocket: (build 234)
Priya Patel: Thanks @Dylan — I'll make kv_caching optional with default false. PR: https://github.com/redwood/instr/pull/482 (working on tests).
Marta Kovacs: Heads up — analytics pipeline expects model_id to be a flat string (not nested). That blocked a join in the daily ETL job this morning. Priya can you ensure model_id is emitted as string?
Priya Patel: Good catch, will flatten model_id to string. ETA for PR update: today EOD. Can someone run a quick smoke after merge? @SRE Oncall
SRE Oncall: I can run the canary smoke at 16:00 PT. Please add a short checklist in the tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xExampleSheet/edit
Alex Chen: Owner list for clarity: Priya — schema & PR; Dylan — staging queries & validation; Marta — analytics join tests; SRE Oncall — smoke/canary run. Milestone: staging smoke + pipeline green by Thu COB. I'll update the tracker unless anyone objects.
Dylan Reyes: :thumbsup: I'll repro locally and paste the failing query into the PR comments so it's easier to test.
Priya Patel: :thumbsup: updating schema now, will attach test events. Ping me in thread if you want sample events to run through the pipeline.
Alex Chen: Thanks team — please keep updates here for audit. If anything blocks the smoke run escalate to pager so we don't miss Thu COB.
